examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Single control only — labels are supplied by the consumer (aria-label here for demo). Selecting it emits its `value`; share a `name` and one `v-model` across instances for a mutually exclusive group.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import RadioButton from '@aziontech/webkit/radio-button'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const selected = ref('')
</script>

<template>
  <RadioButton
    v-model="selected"
    name="webkit-radio"
    value="a"
    input-id="webkit-radio-a"
    aria-label="Option A"
  />
</template>

examples.name: Disabled
examples.summary: Disabled selected and unselected controls sharing one group name, without label chrome.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import RadioButton from '@aziontech/webkit/radio-button'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const selected = ref('a')
</script>

<template>
  <fieldset class="flex items-center gap-(--spacing-4) border-0 p-0 m-0">
    <RadioButton
      v-model="selected"
      name="webkit-radio-disabled"
      value="a"
      disabled
      input-id="webkit-radio-disabled-a"
      aria-label="Disabled selected"
    />
    <RadioButton
      v-model="selected"
      name="webkit-radio-disabled"
      value="b"
      disabled
      input-id="webkit-radio-disabled-b"
      aria-label="Disabled unselected"
    />
  </fieldset>
</template>
